dict.string: Show events from your chosen calendars in the Date & Time agenda. TinyStats reads events only and never changes them.
Use your Mac's current location for weather. TinyStats rounds coordinates and sends them to MET Norway (api.met.no) for forecasts. You can choose a saved Weather city instead.

Send ICMP echo requests to the exact local IP address you enable in Internet Checks, to measure round-trip time. No local-network scan is performed.
